_note: Moonshift's own fleet (FLEET_SOURCE=own, what npm run demo runs): tasks execute only on GPU-A and GPU-B, the GPUs whose shareholders the task pays. External offers in the catalog are the market benchmark only: benchmark names the GPU model, and each GPU's hourly price is the cheapest guaranteed (on-demand) market offer for that model, so a customer never pays more than renting the same GPU elsewhere. pricePerHourUsdc is the price when the catalog has no such offer. endpoint empty = the worker runs in-process.
